scenes.why: Every other ad promises more. Saying what it refuses to do is rarer, and it is in the listing because it is true.

caption.text: A structured symptom timeline: onset, duration and severity as real fields, recorded as it happens.

scenes.why: Then the positive case, on a real screen. Screen: "Family" (One person's card: age, allergies, medications, and tabs for health, vaccines and care team.) chosen because it is the real screen closest to "A structured symptom timeline: onset, duration and severity as real fields, reco"; focus on "Sam (example)".

copy.text: Your family's facts are private to your account.

scenes.why: The privacy line closes the trust argument.
The name lands on a film that has been honest with the viewer.

reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "card"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "card": a binder of cards, so scenes slide in like the next card.
Camera "float": a gentle float that keeps a held frame alive without demanding attention.
Grounds accent → light → light → accent: a warm accent, so light grounds lead and the accent is saved for the turns.
Sound-on placement: every transition, landing and reveal has a cue, and the bed ducks under the brand moment.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on YouTube Short (0.26s a word), inside 12–30s.
